tensorboard_comparison.source: original RSL-RL event files, no local TensorBoard service
tensorboard_comparison.note: Same-length sequential 100-update windows; curriculum and learning time advance. Not a paired causal A/B test.
tensorboard_comparison.mechanical_window_note: 100-update cumulative behavior-history deltas with both ended-episode and environment-second denominators; reason counts may overlap. Derived LocalDiagnostics/MechanicalWindow100 tags appended in original run event directories.

trace_diagnosis.scope: representatives at policy rate; commands, episode_ticks, done and terminated before reset; active includes the first terminal frame
trace_diagnosis.body_pose_scope: representatives every four policy ticks, post-step after possible auto-reset
trace_diagnosis.interpretation: Policy still requests biased wheel targets across commands. Actual wheel speed partly follows them. Reduced negative yaw and drift do not establish command tracking. Body poses are post-step snapshots every four policy ticks and can contain reset state; the policy-rate samples above use active/ticks before reset.

interpretation: All 32 learned-model episodes run their full 10/16-second horizons with original seed 290929 and 1-second warmup, but strict acceptance remains 0/8. Initial model fails before warmup; its zero post-warmup MAE is not acceptance.
Original initial and v4-1024 models reproduce all per-case results from eval008 exactly; settings are unchanged.

Forward +0.5 remains negative at -0.1073 m/s versus -0.1677 before; backward -0.5 is -0.1454 versus -0.1783, so backward error worsens. Negative yaw bias decreases in all cases, while three requested stand heights still cluster near 0.304m.

Full stochastic training block has 0 closure guards and 1.339226mm peak. Matched mechanical history windows improve 88/1823=4.8272% to 0/1252 with equal 24576 environment-seconds. Nonwheel failures remain, and future curriculum exposure is not qualified.
Same-length event mean episode duration falls 13.269 to 12.432 seconds; this is not general behavioral improvement. Dense reward costs are paid and std remains learned Gaussian.

No evidence yet establishes a command-path or reward-payment defect. Continued bounded same-state learning after the authenticated birth repair is warranted by real yaw/drift changes, with explicit tracking failures retained.

next_phase.hypothesis: Test whether negative yaw/translation bias continues correcting with 512 more updates after the birth repair; no reward, physics, schedule, std or thresholds changed.
next_phase.after_exit: Repeat original eight cases on initial, v5-1152 and v5-1664 with traces; compare matched original-event costs, command response and normalized mechanical rates. If progress stalls, diagnose control/command/reward contribution before extending again.
next_phase.checkpoint_schedule: Normal interval 500 remains; next periodic learning-state seal at lineage 1500 (348 additional updates), final 1664. No new first-update seal is requested.
